prompt: Manchester: a canal towpath running under a long row of red-brick Victorian railway arches, every arch bricked-in space turned into a home of tarps and pallets, narrowboats moored nose to tail full of people, mill buildings dark behind. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
